alert_news.title: World Space Week 2026: 8 Milestone ISRO Missions That Made India A Space Power
bullets: India's first satellite Aryabhata launched on 19 April 1975 by ISRO, marking the start of India's space program.
Aryabhata carried experiments in X‑ray astronomy, solar physics and aeronomy.

alert_news.title: Ladakh Launches India's First High-Altitude Snow Leopard Safari
bullets: India’s first high‑altitude snow‑leopard safari launched in Leh, Ladakh on 7 Oct 2026, a collaboration between the Department of Forest, Ecology and Environment, UT Ladakh and the Snow Leopard & High‑Altitude Nature Conservation Society.
The safari uses specially designed open‑back vehicles to traverse Rumbak, Shang and Uley, aiming to promote responsible wildlife tourism and community‑based conservation in the region.
This initiative marks the first time snow‑leopard wildlife tourism is offered at high altitude in India, creating a new model for sustainable livelihoods for local communities.

alert_news.title: Who Is Nigar Shaji? The Project Director of India's Aditya‑L1 Solar Mission
bullets: Aditya‑L1, launched by ISRO in September 2023, is India’s first solar‑mission satellite placed at the Sun‑Earth L1 Lagrangian point to study solar wind and space weather.
The mission, led by Project Director Nigar Shaji, will monitor the Sun’s corona and provide continuous data on solar activity, a capability previously unavailable to India.
Aditya‑L1 represents the first Indian mission to conduct in‑space solar research, marking a milestone in India’s space science and technology.

alert_news.title: India’s First Fleet Support Ship 'Surya' Unveiled by Defence Minister
bullets: India’s first indigenously designed and built Fleet Support Ship (FSS‑1) ‘INS Surya’ launched at Hindustan Shipyard Limited, Visakhapatnam, by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh.

The 43,500‑tonne ship offers at‑sea replenishment of fuel, water, ammunition, dry stores, maintenance workshops, a helicopter deck and self‑defence systems, marking the first of a five‑ship programme worth ~Rs 19,000 crore.
HSL’s upgraded Slipway‑4 and a 300‑tonne Goliath crane enable construction of vessels up to 45,000 DWT, enhancing India’s indigenous naval shipbuilding capacity.

alert_news.title: India’s First Indigenous HPV Vaccine Receives WHO Pre‑qualification
bullets: Cervavac, India’s first indigenously developed HPV vaccine, pre‑qualified by WHO, developed by Serum Institute of India (SII) with the Department of Biotechnology, BIRAC, WHO IARC and Gates Foundation.
Quadrivalent, gender‑neutral vaccine protects against HPV strains 6, 11, 16 and 18 for ages 9‑26, enabling global procurement by UN agencies.

alert_news.title: Airtel Business launches India's first telco-grade network - Bisinfotech
bullets: India’s first telco‑grade network intelligence platform, Airtel IQ Gateway, launched nationwide by Airtel Business.
DPDP‑compliant platform integrating SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, voice and number verification into a single control plane.

alert_news.title: Airtel Business Unveils IQ Gateway: India's First Telco-Grade Enterprise Messaging Platform
bullets: First telco‑grade network intelligence platform in India, launched by Airtel Business, integrating SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, voice and number verification into a single DPDP‑compliant control plane
Provides fraud protection, DLT template management, automatic routing and silent authentication for enterprise communications

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous Fleet Support Ship ‘Surya’ Launched at Hindustan Shipyard, Vizag
bullets: First indigenous Fleet Support Ship (FSS‑1 ‘Surya’) built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited, Visakhapatnam for the Indian Navy
Displacement 43,500 tonnes; capable of replenishing warships at sea; constructed under Make‑in‑India with slipway capacity up to 45,000 DWT

alert_news.title: India’s First Advanced Ergonomics & Human Factors Research Centre Set Up in Pune
bullets: First Advanced Ergonomics and Human Factors Research Centre (AEHFRC) in India, jointly established by ARAI and COEP Technological University in Pune
38,000 sq ft facility with Rs 105 crore investment; will serve automotive, defence, aerospace, rail, agriculture and other sectors, evolving into a national centre of excellence
